identification: Victorian flame mahogany oval swing toilet (dressing table) mirror on carved C-scroll supports, serpentine breakfront base with figured veneer, bun feet. Looks genuine, c1860-80. No marble top, no drawers. Photo shows a good figured base top with light wear.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) with toilet mirror mahogany, toilet mirror, dressing table mirror swing, swing mirror mahogany, oval mirror victorian; one WebSearch for Victorian mahogany oval swing toilet mirror serpentine base. Gowans toilet mirrors since 2025 (about 30) have median $80 hammer, mostly $45-110; Armitage mahogany toilet mirrors median about $60, top $155 (plus $270 for a Georgian two-drawer). Outliers at Gowans $400 and $160. Generic category, so stopped early. Dealer pages not opened. eBay sold listings would add little.
viewing_check: Check the plate (cracks, silvering loss), veneer lifting or loss on the base and C-scroll joints, that the swing screws and uprights are firm and not split, and for any loose feet or old repairs. Sound with intact scrolls supports the upper range; damage puts it at $40-60.
